decisions.reason: The product's own website page and fit with the established camera business indicate results at or above aspiration, so a withdrawal is unlikely.
Its modular product line with several models signals strong commitment and broad market potential, keeping it clearly above aspirations.
Although only a website mention suggests uncertain traction, organisational slack and its strategic fit in miniaturized LiDAR support carrying it for another period.
As a radiation-hard space camera line with its own page and close to established offerings, it likely meets aspirations and warrants keeping.
